facts.claim: 本章开篇把警局失窃笑话建立在把 nothing to go on（没有线索）坐实为字面义上：厕所被偷，于是真的没有可坐/可依据之物。
facts.quote: The police station has been broken into and all the toilets stolen. Officers say they have nothing to go on.

facts.claim: 紧接着的车轮被偷笑话用 tirelessly（不倦/没有轮胎）双关，同一招把办案用语按字面读。
facts.quote: All the police cars in the area have had their wheels stolen, so officers will be working tirelessly to find the culprits.

facts.claim: 裸体营地篱笆破洞被归入警方例行表态，靠 looking into it（往里看/调查）的字面义取笑。
facts.quote: A hole has been found in the fence of a nudist colony. Police say they are looking into it.

facts.claim: 假发厂三吨头发失窃，把 combing the area（地毯式搜查/梳理）的字面义直接演出来。
facts.quote: Three tons of hair has been stolen from a wig factory. Police are combing the area.

facts.claim: 高尔夫球杆杀夫笑话把‘打了几下’答成‘给我记六杆’，把凶案换算成高尔夫计分。
facts.quote: ‘I don’t remember,’ she says. ‘Put me down for a six.

facts.claim: 监狱编号笑话整段讲‘笑话被编号、只报数字’，最后以‘是你说的方法不对’点出笑话的表演性。
facts.quote: ‘We’ve all been here for so long that we know all the jokes,’ says his cellmate.

facts.claim: 偷斯特拉迪瓦里琴书的小偷被写成‘有小提琴前科’，靠 violins/violence 同音。
facts.quote: Police hunting a robber who stole a book about Stradivarius have warned the public not to approach him. He has a history of violins.

facts.claim: 章末把偷门/栅栏写成 take a fence（take offence 冒犯），劝人别对危险罪犯开口。
facts.quote: What do you say to a dangerous criminal who’s stolen your gate? Nothing. He might take a fence.

relations.pair: 厕所失窃 / 宠物店失窃
relations.relation: 两则都以警方‘没有线索’收尾，分别把 nothing to go on 与 no leads（没有牵狗绳）按字面坐实，是同一双关机制的连续演示。
relations.quote: The pet shop nearest the police station has been burgled. Officers say they have no leads.

relations.pair: 香肠团伙 / 霸王龙军火商
relations.relation: 把执法动词与食材、体型并置：grilling（烤问）落到香肠上，small arms（小型武器）落到短手霸王龙身上。
relations.quote: A gang of sausages have been charged with criminal conspiracy. Police are grilling the suspects.

relations.pair: 甜甜圈案 / 汽水击头
relations.relation: 用物品的物理属性（有洞/是软饮）把犯罪与伤害消解为无害，案情本身成了双关材料。
relations.quote: A suspect arrested for stealing a box of doughnuts has been released. The case was full of holes.

numbers.meaning: 警局新得的蜜蜂数量，为 sting operation（蜇人/钓鱼执法）双关提供规模依据。
numbers.quote: Local police have recently acquired 10,000 bees. They are to be used in a sting operation.

numbers.meaning: 假发厂被偷头发的重量，撑起 combing（梳理/搜查）双关。
numbers.quote: Three tons of hair has been stolen from a wig factory. Police are combing the area.

numbers.meaning: 被偷两只却找回六十八只，用数字错位制造荒诞。
numbers.quote: Two rabbits were stolen from a pet shop last week. Only sixty-eight have been recovered.

numbers.meaning: 电影院小卖部被劫金额，与两份汽水、三份爆米花、一个热狗的清单并列。
numbers.quote: Criminals robbed the snack counter at the local cinema and got away with over £2,000 worth of goods: two large fizzy drinks, three medium popcorns and a hot dog.
